faqs.question: What belongs on the first-discussion agenda for a General Counsel / Chief Legal Officer in Retail and E-commerce?

Ask how customers, store or digital teams, suppliers, brand partners, operations, and owners participate, which decisions are assigned to the role, and what evidence the employer wants to discuss. Record unanswered questions about location and working conditions before deciding whether to proceed.
